summary: Shows previewing tags with --list-tags and tagged tasks with --tags ... --list-tasks without running anything; neither shows content inside dynamic includes.
questions: How do I see all tags in a playbook?
How do I preview which tasks a tag will run?
Why doesn't --list-tags show tags in my included files?

answer_card.title: Previewing tags and tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook example.yml --list-tags
ansible-playbook example.yml --tags "configuration,packages" --list-tasks
```

Nothing is executed. Limitation: tags and tasks inside **dynamic includes** aren't shown.
